topic: Same-S* pause can preserve enumerated Runtime state without proving full fixed work
mechanism: At one cohort's natural first completed-slot boundary, fence all local streams, capture enumerated Target/Host/Draft/Serving state, execute pause-only handling without another model step, fence and recapture before resume. This tests state mutation by the pause transition on the captured fields under the exact same entry state.

observed: All8 admitted measured cohort5 natural boundary cycle187 slot4. Sixty captured tensors and 175975620 cloned bytes/rank had equal values and storage/shape/stride descriptions before/after pause handling; pending scheduling and Host-copy flags were false. Client 96 requests, all8 trace admission, tagged cleanup, source restore and SHA gates passed.
failure_or_limit: The probe leaves actual_seq_lengths_q and attn_state opaque and does not clone full physical Target/Draft KV. torch.equal is not bitwise signed-zero identity. revalidate_when: If legal early release again becomes the highest-value Scheduling uncertainty, extend same-S* coverage to full Target/Draft KV and model-readable opaque state, then compare a matched in-place continuation with complete write-set restoration and all8 ownership before timing or publication claims.
